items.title: Top Stock Reports for Oracle, Merck & Union Pacific
items.summary: Oracle, Merck and Union Pacific lead today's stock reports, with cloud growth, drug sales and rail strength driving their investment stories.

items.title: Is AbbVie Stock Too Reliant On Skyrizi?
items.summary: AbbVie (ABBV) trades at $256.46, roughly 96% of its 52-week high, after returning 24.1% over the past twelve months against 19.7% for the S&P 500. That price buys a business where about a third of guided 2026 revenue comes from one drug. The market reads that concentration as strength. It is worth reading it the other way too.

items.title: MRNA Stock Soars 143% in a Month: Time to Buy, Hold or Sell?
items.summary: Moderna stock surges 143% in a month on positive cancer therapy results, but competition and valuation raise key questions for investors.

items.title: What Merck Stopped Saying About GARDASIL Should Change What You Watch
items.summary: Merck (MRK) has returned about 85% over the past year and at about $150 trades roughly 4% below its 52-week high. A year ago, management spent earnings calls managing fallout from a steep drop in GARDASIL sales. That problem has left the lead. What management opens with instead is a much larger claim, and it settles years from now.

items.title: Merck Trading Near 52-Week High: Is the Stock a Buy, Hold or Sell?
items.summary: MRK trades near its 52-week high as Keytruda drives growth, while its pipeline and new products offer a path beyond the 2028 patent cliff.

items.title: The Cure for Cancer is Becoming an Investable Opportunity: Analyst Sees $600 Million for Tempus AI
items.summary: Personalized cancer vaccines are creating a diagnostics investment opportunity beyond Moderna and Merck, with tumor sequencing at its center.

items.title: Forget the Dividend. This Could Be the Real Reason to Buy Pfizer Stock Now
items.summary: Pfizer's 5.91% yield draws most of the headlines, but a quietly rerated stock and a pipeline loaded with 2026 catalysts are building a separate case altogether for investors willing to look past the dividend.

items.title: Moderna Just Doubled Overnight, and 2 More Healthcare Stocks Could Follow It
items.summary: Moderna, Pharvaris and AbbVie span short, mid and long-term healthcare setups, from melanoma data to a Phase 3 catalyst and 13 straight years of dividend hikes.
